title: K 个逆序对数组
summary: 统计由 1 到 n 组成且恰好有 k 个逆序对的不同数组数量，结果对 10^9+7 取模。
insight: 把新最大数 n 插入长度 n-1 的排列，可新增 0 到 n-1 个逆序对；用滑动窗口前缀和把转移优化为 O(nk)。
pitfalls: 只需计算到 k 个逆序对
窗口左端超过 i-1 个新增逆序对时要减去
减法取模后需恢复非负

solutions.title: 逆序对数量滚动窗口 DP
solutions.idea: 对每个长度用上一层连续区间和生成当前计数。
steps: 长度 length 从 1 到 n，维护 window 累加 previous[inversions]
当 inversions>=length 时减 previous[inversions-length]，写入 current 后滚动

code.java: class Solution { public int kInversePairs(int n,int k){long mod=1000000007L;long[] previous=new long[k+1];previous[0]=1;for(int length=1;length<=n;length++){long[] current=new long[k+1];long window=0;for(int inversions=0;inversions<=k;inversions++){window=(window+previous[inversions])%mod;if(inversions>=length)window=(window-previous[inversions-length]+mod)%mod;current[inversions]=window;}previous=current;}return(int)previous[k];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun kInversePairs(n:Int,k:Int):Int{val mod=1000000007L;var previous=LongArray(k+1);previous[0]=1;for(length in 1..n){val current=LongArray(k+1);var window=0L;for(inversions in 0..k){window=(window+previous[inversions])%mod;if(inversions>=length)window=(window-previous[inversions-length]+mod)%mod;current[inversions]=window};previous=current};return previous[k].toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int kInversePairs(int n,int k){const long long mod=1000000007;vector<long long> previous(k+1);previous[0]=1;for(int length=1;length<=n;++length){vector<long long> current(k+1);long long window=0;for(int inversions=0;inversions<=k;++inversions){window=(window+previous[inversions])%mod;if(inversions>=length)window=(window-previous[inversions-length]+mod)%mod;current[inversions]=window;}previous.swap(current);}return previous[k];} };
